task_definition.task_description: Please look up the Hilton Tokyo and find Alice in the company directory, confirm which Alice it is, then check her availability for 2026-01-16. After that, find meeting rooms for 8 people starting at 10:00 that day, pick the smallest suitable room, prepare the reservation details for 10:00–11:00, book it, and then email Alice a high-priority note titled “Trip Meeting Coordination” saying the meeting room was booked successfully.
